newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Israeli ADRs mixed in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Israeli ADRs mixed in subdued trade.

text.p: Israeli shares were mixed in U.S. trading on Tuesday, following a quiet session in Tel Aviv, traders said.

Investors continue to remain on the sidelines awaiting news on the peace talks between Israelis and Palestinians. Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat met Israeli president Ezer Weizman in Caesarea today, a meeting viewed as a positive step in the long awaited peace process between the two.
The meeting is Arafat's first public visit to Israel.
Nice Systems was down one at 22-1/2 on investor profit-taking after recent gains.

Telecommunications ADRs were among Tuesday's biggest movers. Israeli telecommunications firms Teledata Communications Ltd, up one at 18-7/8, and ECI Telecom, up 7/8 to 21-3/8, also topped Israeli ADRs most active list.

Elsewhere, Telecom Argentina was up one to 43 on the NYSE. Oppenheimer & Co reduced its fiscal 1996 and 1997 earnings per ADR estimates earlier on Tuesday. Indonesia's PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (TELKOM) fell 1-1/4 to 30 on the NYSE, after the company's ADR fell in London.
